verdict.rationale: An authenticator product could plausibly offer official SDKs for developers to integrate its sign-in, push-approval or Verified ID flows, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only end-user app features (OTP codes, push approvals, passkeys, backup, Verified ID usage) and contains no official SDK. The probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, which reinforces that no developer-facing surface is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
